# pronto events

Package events defines the pronto event vocabulary, subscription filters,
and the in-process event bus used to fan events out to socket subscribers.


## Event types

| Type | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `ci_passed` | indicates CI checks on a PR transitioned to passing. |
| `ci_failed` | indicates one or more CI checks on a PR transitioned to failing. |
| `conflict` | indicates a PR newly has merge conflicts. |
| `review_received` | indicates a new review was submitted on a PR. |
| `pr_merged` | indicates a PR was merged. |
| `pr_added` | indicates a PR newly appeared in the queue. |
| `pr_removed` | indicates a PR left the queue without merging. |
| `queue_refreshed` | reports the outcome of a queue poll. It is not scoped to a single PR. |
| `fetch_progress` | reports incremental progress of an in-flight queue fetch. It is not scoped to a single PR and is not a notification trigger. |

## ReviewPayload

ReviewPayload carries details for review_received events.

## Event

Event is a single emitted pronto event. Seq is monotonic per server lifetime; Repo, PR, and Title are set for PR-scoped events.

| Field | JSON | Type | Omitempty | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ---- | --------- | ----------- |
| `Seq` | `seq` | `uint64` |  | — |
| `Type` | `type` | `Type` |  | — |
| `TS` | `ts` | `time.Time` |  | — |
| `Repo` | `repo` | `string` | yes | — |
| `PR` | `pr` | `int` | yes | — |
| `Title` | `title` | `string` | yes | — |
| `Payload` | `payload` | `any` | yes | — |

## Subscription

Subscription filters the event stream. Empty fields match anything; set fields must all match.

| Field | JSON | Type | Omitempty | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ---- | --------- | ----------- |
| `Types` | `types` | `[]Type` | yes | — |
| `Repo` | `repo` | `string` | yes | — |
| `PR` | `pr` | `int` | yes | — |
